children: INDIAN IMMUNOLOGICALS- STATEMENT ON RABIES VACCINE ABHAYRAB
INDIAN IMMUNOLOGICS - RECEIVED QUERIES FROM HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS REGARDING RABIES VACCINE ABHAYRAB BATCH NUMBER KE25012PROFESSIONALS REGARDING ABHAYRAB BATCH NUMBER KE25012
IIL - DURING AN ENFORCEMENT ACTION THE CDSCO DREW VACCINE SAMPLES FROM AN UNLICENSED RESIDENTIAL PREMISES LOCATED AT MUKHERJEE NAGAR, DELHI
IIL - THE VIALS CARRIED THE LABEL OF ABHAYRAB, BATCH NO. KE25012; SAMPLES WERE REPORTED AS NOT OF STANDARD QUALITY (NSQ) AND MISBRANDED UPON ANALYSIS
IIL - THE VIALS EXAMINED ARE NOT A PRODUCT MANUFACTURED BY HUMAN BIOLOGICALS INSTITUTE
IIL - NO MARKET COMPLAINT HAS BEEN RECEIVED IN RESPECT OF THE BATCH NUMBER KE25012
IIL - WE SUBMITTED OUR BATCH MANUFACTURING, QUALITY CONTROL, RECONCILIATION AND DISTRIBUTION RECORDS TO THE CDSCO ON 14.08.2026
IIL - WE HAVE ASKED THE AUTHORITIES TO TRACE THE SOURCE OF THESE VIALS AND TO ACT AGAINST THOSE RESPONSIBLE
